summary: Fixed all 5 critical issues: (1) auth.ts uses user.role==='admin' instead of missing user.isAdmin field; (2) fulfill route calls sendFulfillmentEmail with correct (email, name, bibleCount, trackingNumber) signature; (3) Stripe webhook handler implemented at /api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts handling checkout.session.completed; (4) next.config.mjs suppressions removed — TypeScript compiles cleanly; (5) Prisma migration 20240101000000_init added, package.json scripts updated with db:migrate and db:migrate:dev.
knownIssues: No DATABASE_URL is set in this sandbox so Prisma migrations cannot be run against a live DB here; the migration SQL is committed and ready for deploy.
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET must be set in production environment for webhook verification to work.
Stripe API version '2023-10-16' is pinned as 'as any' cast in stripe.ts - should be updated to match installed stripe SDK version.
nextStep: Set DATABASE_URL and run 'npm run db:migrate' in the production/staging environment. Set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var and register the /api/webhooks/stripe endpoint in the Stripe dashboard.
